rationale.rules-based-checks: Executable specifications and deterministic tests form the proposed quality gate.
rationale.ai-review: Experiments characterize correlated failures and define AI review's legitimate residual.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Accelerated generation shifts the bottleneck toward auditing and verification.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes deploying AI reviewers as the primary response to AI-code quality.
rationale.steering: Specifications substantively constrain generation as well as verify resulting artifacts.
